fusions.name: Writ of Summons
fusions.desc: Serves a writ that deals 30 damage and curses the target, plus 5% of the maximum health of a boss or elite it hits.

fusions.name: Sheaf Flutter
fusions.desc: Flutters 3 pages at once, each dealing 5 damage, knocking its target back 2 tiles and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Standing Orders
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
